text:
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
inspection list I1, to be performed every six months bases as indicated by M6 in 
the above title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Ragab Goada 
 Abo-Zeed tested by eng. Emad Abraheem Gooda, accepted by general manager eng. 
 Hassan Saeed Dosoki , approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of 
 Damanhour power station and 
 certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia: WDEPC

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear the safety and 
 healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves ...etc
Shutdown the pump.
Circuit breaker of pump 
 racked out.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Cleaning fluid rags
Oil Mobil DTE medium
Work to be carried out
Rain the old oil from the pump 
 bearing
Clean the pump bearing housing
Add the new oil to the proper 
 level (mobil DTE medium)
Check for any leakage
